snippet.title: The Eternal Life of Goldman | Steam Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Weappy Studios proudly presents the free Steam demo of The Eternal Life of Goldman!

Starting today and available beyond Steam Next Fest, you can dive into the adventure right from the very beginning.

Play the demo: http://thqn.net/TELoG-demo-steam
